# Payment API timeouts { #payment-api-timeouts }

The upstream card processor timeout is **10 seconds**. Retry once, then return HTTP 504.

## Where the timeout is set { #where-the-timeout-is-set }

The timeout is injected into path operations with `Depends(get_processor_client)`.
